name: Delivery to Archmage Xylem
label: Quest
description: Delivery to Archmage Xylem: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This final tablet goes to someone very dangerous, friend. Heed me when I tell you that I trust this person far less than anyone else I've asked you to meet with.

Archmage Xylem has a tower up in the hills overlooking Azshara. He's human, but he acts like no human I've met... Or killed. He exudes power, and I dare not ask him what he plans on doing with the tablet.
He came to me, but told me that his bodyguard Sanath would help me get to the tower when I was ready to meet him. Look north for Sanath.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What can I help you with, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, the Tablet of Sael'hai... How long I've longed to study it.
Thank you, friend. You may tell Jediga that she has done well. This will definitely be worth the payment she asked for.
